verdict: No paid ads are running; organic traffic holds but needs a capture mechanism.
narrative: No paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads across the full 28-day window, so your Google Business Profile was the only source bringing people to you — delivering 58 actions in total. GBP activity dropped 43.75% in the most recent week, with the last three days recording zero actions, a confirmed short-term fade. At the same time, your website saw 186 sessions from 145 visitors this period, and organic site interest ticked up 42.86% week-over-week — meaning people are finding you, but nothing on the site is converting that interest into leads. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority so lead flow has a reliable engine again.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions (directions, clicks, calls) this period
website sessions this period from organic visitors
leads captured across all channels in the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: 186 organic sessions this period are arriving at the site but producing zero leads — no intake mechanism is catching them.
watch_item.fix: A site conversion path is being reviewed and addressed in parallel with paid campaign reactivation.
